The Case For More Mega-Cap Outperformance

Tan Kai Xian

Gavekal Research | 2 Nov 2026

October was a tough month for the mega-cap tech stocks that have driven US market outperformance over the last 10 years. Since early October, Nvidia has fallen -14.5%, Meta -17.1% and Alphabet -20.4% as investors have grown nervous about how the AI capex boom is being financed and jittery about the returns big tech companies will earn on the trillions they have poured in so far. As a result, since the end of September, the S&P 500 market-cap-weighted index, which is dominated by mega-cap tech stocks, has underperformed the S&P 500 equal-weighted index by -6pp.So, is the era of mega-cap outperformance coming to its end? There are solid reasons to think not.
